title: Contains aa but does not end in a: a difference
notes: A accepts words containing aa; B accepts words ending in a. A − B keeps the pairs where A accepts and B does not: only (p2, q0), words that have seen aa and end in b. Four of the six pairs are reachable.
ops: start p0; accept p2; p0 a -> p1; p0 b -> p0; p1 a -> p2; p1 b -> p0; p2 a,b -> p2 | start q0; accept q1; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q0; q1 a -> q1; q1 b -> q0
